score_labels.0: Blank, nonsensical, off-topic, or a different creature with no usable partial match.
score_labels.1: Very vague or mostly incorrect name; only a weak clue toward the correct creature.
score_labels.2: Partly correct name: one meaningful component correct, but another component missing or wrong.
score_labels.3: Almost correct name: minor spelling, word-order, pluralisation, or article error that still clearly identifies the creature.
score_labels.4: Correct creature name or an unambiguous spelling variant.

score_labels.0: Blank, nonsensical, off-topic, or contains no correct creature-specific fact.
score_labels.1: One weak, generic, or only partly correct fact; little creature-specific information.
score_labels.2: One correct creature-specific fact, or two partially correct facts.
score_labels.3: Two correct creature-specific facts, or one correct fact plus a strong partial fact.
score_labels.4: Three correct creature-specific facts, or an equivalently complete and specific answer.

score_labels.0: Blank, nonsensical, off-topic, or describes another creature.
score_labels.1: One very broad visual feature only; could apply to many creatures.
score_labels.2: One clear correct visual feature, or two weak/partial visual features.
score_labels.3: Two clear correct visual features, or one precise distinctive feature plus partial support.
score_labels.4: Detailed, distinctive visual description that would let another person recognise the creature.

score_labels.0: Blank, nonsensical, off-topic, or wrong chapter/environment.
score_labels.1: Very vague location; no correct chapter, but a weak clue may fit the correct environment.
score_labels.3: Correct chapter/environment plus a partly correct specific place or contextual detail.
score_labels.4: Correct chapter/environment plus a specific place or spatial/contextual detail.
